title: Protect, react, deprotect
caption: To reduce the ester of a keto-ester without touching the ketone, first protect the ketone as an acetal (with ethane-1,2-diol and acid), carry out the reduction with LiAlH₄, then remove the acetal with aqueous acid.
alt: A flow: keto-ester → acetal-protected keto-ester → reduced (ester to alcohol) → deprotected hydroxy-ketone.
description: Protect: ketone → acetal with HOCH₂CH₂OH, H⁺.
React: LiAlH₄ reduces the ester; the acetal is unaffected.
